lessons.title: Wise words

grammar.title: Third conditional and should have
grammar.shortAr: للمستحيل في الماضي: If + past perfect, would have + participle. وللندم: should/shouldn’t have.
points: If + past perfect, would have + past participle: unreal past situations.
could have / might have describe less certain past results.
should/shouldn’t have + past participle talks about regrets.
table: If I had woken up on time, I wouldn’t have missed the bus.
We would have left early if we’d known about the traffic.
If I’d known she was at the party, I might have come.
I should have bought my ticket yesterday.
exceptions: Use could/might have for less certain results.

vocab.example: Best piece of advice you’ve been given?
Third conditionals often express regrets.
I should’ve been nicer.
You shouldn’t’ve paid attention to him.
Look after your health — health is wealth.
He told me to follow my heart.

lessons.title: Life lessons
goals: Talk about past habits and states

grammar.title: would (past habits)
grammar.shortAr: would للعادات الماضية المتكررة، وused to للعادات والحالات التي تغيّرت. لا نستخدم would للحالة.
points: would + verb describes repeated past habits; past simple also works.
used to describes past habits or states which have changed.
Do not use would for past states: As a child, I was curious.
table: My father would read to me every night.
As a child, I used to love reading.
I used to feel isolated in New Zealand.
We would always see them in the afternoon.
exceptions: Would cannot describe a past state.

grammar.title: How to give a presentation
grammar.shortAr: عبارات البداية، عرض النقاط، الخاتمة، والتعامل مع الأسئلة الصعبة.
points: Start: Thanks for coming… / Today I’m going to talk about…
Signpost: The first point…, Moving on to…, As a final point…
Finish: To sum up… / Just to recap…; for hard questions: I’ll get back to you on that.
table: Thanks for coming / Today I’m going to talk about…
Moving on to my next point…

vocab.example: Can I get a show of hands?

lessons.title: Dragons’ Den

grammar.title: Pitch language (review)
grammar.shortAr: لغة العرض التجاري: وصف المشروع والسوق، أرقام المبيعات، طلب الاستثمار، وأسئلة المستثمرين.
points: Present the business and market: The market is worth £750 million.
Give figures: Our turnover figures have been €70,000, €100,000 and €150,000.
State the offer and answer questions: We’re asking for €100,000 for a ten percent share.
table: We run a business called Live Your Life Adventure Holidays.
The market for coconut oil is worth around £750 million.
We’re asking for €100,000 for a ten percent share.
